definitions.explanation: The legal right to participate in elections by casting a vote.

examples.japanese: {選挙権|せんきょけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: To obtain the right to vote.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十八歳|じゅうはっさい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{選挙権|せんきょけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In Japan, you have the right to vote from age eighteen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成年|せいねん}→成年：00456_seinen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}する→達する：02129_tassuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{選挙権|せんきょけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得|え}られる→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: Upon reaching adulthood, one can obtain the right to vote.

notes:
The legal right to vote in elections.

FORMS:
⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧ (election) + {権|けん} (right)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {選挙権|せんきょけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have the right to vote
- {選挙権|せんきょけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧: to gain the right to vote
- {選挙権|せんきょけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行使|こうし}→行使：14087_koushi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to exercise one's right to vote
- {選挙権|せんきょけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧: to grant the right to vote

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, the voting age was lowered from 20 to 18 in 2016. Japanese citizenship is required — permanent residents do not have {選挙権|せんきょけん} in national elections.
